2 زنّاهُ , inf. n. تَزْنِيَةٌ, (S, Mgh, Msb, TA,) He said to him يَا زَانِى [O fornicator or adulterer]: (S, TA:) or he imputed to him الزِّنَا [i. e. fornication or adultery]; (Mgh, Msb, TA;) and so ↓ زاناهُ , accord. to the copies of the K; but in the M, ↓ ازناهُ , which, it is there said, has not been heard except in a trad. of the daughter of El- Hasan. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also 1. ＝
-A3- And see 2 in art. زنو.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
